name: one-more-mobile
description: Android and iOS apps for ONE MORE (Capacitor). The apps load https://onemoregame.me and add native haptics, sharing, back-button handling, a splash screen and an offline practice mode.

scripts.sync: npm run build:offline && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.add:android: npm run build:offline && npx cap add android && npm run assets && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.add:ios: npm run build:offline && npx cap add ios && npm run assets && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
